changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'OrganizationRegistration') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[OrganizationRegistration]( [ID] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_OrganizationRegistration_ID] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [OrganizationID] [int] NOT NULL, [Email] [nvarchar](500) NOT NULL, [Step] [int] NOT NULL, [RegisteredStartedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [RegisteredCompletedOn] [datetime] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_OrganizationRegistration] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_OrganizationRegistration_Organization') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[OrganizationRegistration] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_OrganizationRegistration_Organization] FOREIGN KEY([OrganizationID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Organization] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[OrganizationRegistration] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_OrganizationRegistration_Organization] END
